rules.statement: The first defendant's acquiescence in the partnership deed being drawn up with the second defendant as a partner, subject to his claim to draw as much money from the business as the other partners had drawn, does not amount to such a recognition of the second defendant's right as would estop the first defendant now from asserting that the second defendant has no legal right.
rules.supporting_quote: I do not think that first defendant's acquiescence in the partnership deed being drawn up with the second defendant as a partner, subject to his claim to draw as much money from the business as the other partners had drawn, amounts to such a recognition of the second defendant's right as would estop the first defendant now from asserting that second defendant has no legal right.
